sentences.en: Conformity is an essential element of our homogeneous community.
sentences.zh: 同质性社区中，一致性是必不可少的元素。

sentences.en: Conformity is the jailer of freedom and the enemy of growth.
sentences.zh: 一致性是自由的看守者，也是成长的敌人。

sentences.en: Some people prefer conformity, while others seek novelty.
sentences.zh: 有些人偏好一致性，而另一些人则寻求新鲜事物。

senses.zh: 遵守，依照；随大流，循规蹈矩；符合，一致；信奉英国国教
